source: const r = await external_lookup({id: 21}); console.log(r.value); return r.value;
toolDescriptionSeenByModel: Execute TypeScript code in a secure sandbox environment. The code can use these external API functions: external_lookup, external_failing. All external_* calls are async and must be awaited. Return a value to pass results back. Use console.log() for debugging. The tool returns { success, result, logs, error }, where result is the value your code returned.
